disposition.reason: The Town of Halifax brought this enforcement action to compel removal of a temporary shed after an unappealed notice of violation; no municipal decision was appealed to the court in this docket, and the subject is a shed, not new housing.

evidence.quote: The Town of Halifax (Town) brings this enforcement action against Defendants Bonnie LeMay and Richard Jeffrey, alleging that a shed on Defendant LeMay's property has outlasted its temporary permit
Defendants did not appeal the ZBA decision.
The Town filed its Complaint with this Court on June 22, 2018.

judgments.note: Town-initiated enforcement under 24 V.S.A. 4451/4452 after defendants failed to appeal the January 2018 NOV and the ZBA decision; nothing in this docket appeals a municipal decision.
Enforcement the town brought without an appeal of a municipal decision; the guide classes this as no.
The dispute is removal of a 10-by-12 storage shed (accessory structure). A separate temporary-housing permit after the 2016 fire is mentioned only as background and is not at issue.

history.note: Excluded: town enforcement action over a shed, no municipal appeal, not new housing.
